//: Rendered per task by the agent-plane supervisor: {env:*} placeholders are filled from the task env; the plugin entries resolve to the vendored integrations/opencode/plugins/* packages (loading mechanics = RFC-0009 probe item). This file is the `open`-mode shape; other modes get their own rendering.

lci-open.description: Lightbridge open mode: reads the ticket, investigates, edits, builds and tests in the sandbox, then proposes a PR via the mediated lightbridge_propose_pr tool. Never pushes, never merges.

research.description: Read-only investigation: navigate the checkout and the Lightbridge retrieval tools (semantic + graph search) to answer a focused question. Returns findings with file:line evidence; makes no edits and runs no commands.

capture.description: Capture and structure context for the record: summarize decisions, evidence, and verification results into the structured payloads the mediated Lightbridge tools expect (findings, progress reports, PR body with the AI-usage declaration).
